* '''Playtest''' (this page, 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-mazscastlehiddenrecess-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/mazscastlehiddenrecess.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Once per game, if you control, may retrieve a weapon or device into hand.” Dark Side: “Instead of Force draining here, may retrieve a weapon or device.”
* '''Original''' ([[Maz's Castle: Hidden Recess]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-mazscastlehiddenrecess-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/mazscastlehiddenrecess.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Once per game, if you control, may retrieve a weapon or device into hand.” Dark Side: “Instead of Force draining here, may retrieve a weapon or device.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics, and the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added; the image is now stored as a landscape site card (it was stored upright on 1 August); same words.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Maz's Castle: Hidden Recess (Errata)]], 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-mazscastlehiddenrecess.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/mazscastlehiddenrecess.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Once per game, if you control, may retrieve a weapon or device into hand.” Dark Side: “Instead of Force draining here, may retrieve a weapon or device.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; re-rendered at high resolution (the credit line now reads “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”).
